Class ImageFactory

java.lang.Object
qmillionaire.view.ImageFactory
public final class ImageFactory extends Object
Builds programmatic placeholder images for the application. Until real artwork is dropped into the images/ folder, the title icon and the main banner are painted on a Canvas and converted into an Image on demand.
